application.name: TypeScript order checkout sample
application.summary: A small TypeScript application simulating an e-commerce checkout flow. It validates/reserves inventory, calculates order pricing with discount and tax, processes a simulated card payment, sends order confirmation email, and returns checkout status. Tests exercise order submission, checkout handling, pricing, and ZIP validation.
application.purpose: Demonstrate an order-processing pipeline across inventory, pricing, billing, notifications, and utility modules.

domains.name: Order checkout orchestration
domains.description: Coordinates stock reservation, pricing, payment, and confirmation into submitOrder and handleCheckout.

domains.name: Inventory / stock reservation
domains.description: Normalizes SKUs, checks inventory, and reserves stock for an order.

domains.name: Pricing / tax / discount
domains.description: Calculates tax, applies discounts, and computes a formatted order total.

domains.name: Billing / payments
domains.description: Simulates card charging and payment processing.

domains.name: Notifications / email
domains.description: Simulates sending order confirmations and payment receipts.

domains.name: Formatting / utility functions
domains.description: Provides currency rounding/formatting, slug generation, and ID generation.

domains.name: Validation / standalone helpers
domains.description: Provides ZIP validation, string hashing, and query-string parsing.

domains.name: Tests
domains.description: Test functions that call order, pricing, and ZIP validation functions.

applicationFacts: The deterministic CALLS graph shows submitOrder as the central checkout orchestrator.
submitOrder first reserves stock; if reserveStock returns false, submitOrder returns false immediately.
submitOrder computes subtotal as price * quantity.
submitOrder calls calculateOrderTotal(subtotal, 0, 0.08), meaning no discount and an 8% tax rate.
submitOrder processes payment using the pre-tax subtotal, not the formatted tax-inclusive total.
submitOrder sends order confirmation to hard-coded 'customer@example.com' using cartId and the formatted total.
submitOrder ignores the boolean result returned by sendOrderConfirmation.
handleCheckout calls submitOrder and returns 'ORDER_PLACED:<cartId>' on success or 'ORDER_FAILED' on failure.
chargeCard returns false for missing cardToken or amount <= 1; otherwise returns true.
checkInventory sanitizes the SKU, rejects empty SKUs or quantity <= 0, and allows quantity <= 100.
reserveStock only succeeds if checkInventory succeeds.
sendEmail requires the recipient to contain '@' and the subject to be non-empty.
calculateTax throws if taxRate is less than 0 or greater than 1.
applyDiscount returns the subtotal unchanged when discountPercentage <= 0.
calculateOrderTotal returns a formatted currency string, not a numeric total.
formatCurrency rounds the amount to two decimals and returns a '$'-prefixed string.
validateZipCode accepts 5-digit ZIP codes and ZIP+4 codes.
Several functions have no incoming CALLS edges in the provided graph: slugify, generateId, renderInvoiceSummary, sendReceiptEmail, hashString, and parseQueryString. Their external usage is unknown.
